chapter: Shows, scripts and the Mosby-era names
title: George Orendorff and Jimmy Strong who came west with Les Hite
summary: Orendorff and Strong arrived with Hite and a touring singer who quit, and Orendorff later worked for the post office.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did George Orendorff ever work with you?
I don't think we ever mentioned him.
He come here with Les Hite in...in...uh, he played with them back East, and they come here, I told you, with a singer. Orendorff and I can't think of the other boys that came here with him. And Les

Hite and so the...Orendorff played with me and Les Hite, and then Orendorff...Orendorff quit playing regular and went into the Post Office. He worked in the Post Office for years and years and years. I don't know if he's living yet or not.
Yeah, he is. I don't know him but Lawrence Brown mentioned him to me.
Jimmy Strong. Is that the one who came here with them?

That's...that's the one, yes. I was just trying to think of his name. Jimmy Strong and the Hite and Orendorff came here with this woman--this singer. I don't remember who her name was now. And the band quit here, see? I guess that was the idea--to come out to California and quit. They didn't...they quit...they left here. She was on the Orpheum, I think.
